subject: Request: Case study + logo & quote — Order Form redlines
messages:
From: Sara Nguyen <sara.novasys@novasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: legal@novasys.com
Date: 2025-05-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Request: Case study + logo & quote — Redwood / Novasys Order Form

Hi Marissa,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the team is excited. We have a marketing opportunity with Novasys' product launch and would love to include Redwood Inference as a highlighted partner. Attached is a draft quote and a first-pass press release with suggested language.

A few asks from our side:
- Can Redwood grant Novasys the right to reference and quote the product relationship in press materials (we're proposing perpetual reference rights in the order form)?
- We'd like an approved one-line customer quote and permission to use your company logo in our press kit and website.
- We also need to confirm any confidentiality carveouts — specifically, can we agree to exclude mutually agreed press statements from the NDA for release purposes?

We can provide a short embargo window (2 weeks) and will share the final release for approval. Timeline is tight — aiming for publication on Jun 12.

Attached: Novasys_Draft_Quote_v1.pdf, Novasys_press_draft.docx

Thanks,
Sara Nguyen
Strategic Partnerships — Novasys
sara.novasys@novasys.com
+1 415-555-0174

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2025-05-28T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Case study + logo & quote — Redwood / Novasys Order Form

Sara — thanks for the materials and congrats on the launch plan. Quick responses and next steps: 

- Reference rights: we typically allow customer reference rights but perpetual, unrestricted reference language is a tough ask for standard order forms. Would Novasys consider a 3-year reference right with an option to request renewal?
- Logo & quote: We're happy to provide a one-line approved quote and the logo asset pack, but we need to review the quote text and final release before sign-off. Our brand guidelines require the logo file and an approved usage spec.
- Confidentiality carveout for press: we can add a limited carveout for mutually approved press statements (final copy must be approved in writing).

Looping in Kimberly for legal redlines and Dev for order-form ops. I've attached RNW_redlines_orderform_v1.pdf with suggested language for the publicity and confidentiality sections and a short checklist for approvals.

Can you confirm whether Novasys needs a perpetual right for case studies specifically, or if the perpetual language in your draft was intended to cover testimonials/marketing broadly? That will affect the escalation path.

Goal: get to final language this week so we can sign and stage assets.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive — Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai
(650) 555-0142

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: 2025-05-28T13:30:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Request: Case study + logo & quote — Redwood / Novasys Order Form

Marissa / Dev — reviewed. Key legal positions and suggested redlines: 

1) Reference Rights (Order Form / MSA):
- Proposed: Redwood grants Customer a non-exclusive, non-transferable, worldwide right to reference Redwood in Customer marketing materials and to use Redwood's name and logo solely in connection with such reference for a period of three (3) years from the Effective Date.
- Rationale: standard, avoids perpetual binding commitments.

2) Press / Publicity Carveout to Confidentiality: 
- Proposed: Notwithstanding any confidentiality obligations in the MSA, both parties may publicly disclose mutually agreed-upon press announcements and customer quotes following written approval of the final release.

3) Logo usage:
- Customer must follow Redwood brand guidelines; logo files to be provided upon execution. Any modification of the logo requires prior written consent.

4) Testimonials / Quotes:
- Redwood reserves the right to approve any customer quote. Approval should not be unreasonably withheld; minor edits for clarity may be made.

5) Escalation: 
- If Customer insists on perpetual or unlimited reference rights, escalate to CRO for approval and provide a compensatory concession (e.g., extended term discount or joined case study benchmark).

I attached legal_redline_msar.docx with in-line redlines and alternative language (accept, propose, escalate). I'll mark the clauses that should not be accepted without exec sign-off.

Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel — Redwood Inference
kimberly_park@redwood.ai

From: Sara Nguyen <sara.novasys@novasys.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Novasys Legal <legal@novasys.com>
Date: 2025-05-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Request: Case study + logo & quote — Redwood / Novasys Order Form

Marissa / Kimberly — thanks for the quick review and suggested language. A few updates from our side: 

- Novasys product marketing prefers a perpetual, irrevocable reference right so we can keep historical case studies on our site and in press kits. If Redwood can't agree to "perpetual," would Redwood consider a 10-year term instead?
- We do need the ability to publish the one-line quote in perpetuity (can't come back to customers repeatedly for re-approval). Is there a way to lock approval for the quote once signed?
- Attached updated press draft and a DocuSign link for the order form. We can accept the 3-year reference for the logo if we get perpetual rights for the final quote line and the right to host the case study indefinitely.

If we need exec-level signoff for tradeoffs, please let me know who to loop. Our timeline is still Jun 12 for publication; any delay on logo assets will push that.

Attachments: Novasys_press_draft.docx
DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embeddedSigning/ABC12345

Best,
Sara

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>

Subject: RE: Request: Case study + logo & quote — Redwood / Novasys Order Form (internal)

Kim / Dev — internal next steps based on Novasys' reply: 

1) Quote permanence: Novasys wants the final one-line quote to be perpetual. Kimberly, can we accept locked approval for the quote text ("approved once in writing by Redwood") so we don't have to re-approve in future? If so, mark that clause in the redline.

2) Reference rights term: they asked for perpetual for case studies or 10 years otherwise. We should hold to 3 years for the general reference right; if the CRO is comfortable we can offer 10 years for a marketing credit or a small commercial concession. Recommend we prepare an option: 3-year standard + optional 10-year for a 10% uplift on the order value or a marketing commitment.

3) Logo assets: Dev, please prepare RNW_brand_assets_v2.zip (SVG/PNG + usage guide) and set up a shared drive folder with the final files. Share Drive link: https://drive.google.com/drive/fakefolder/novasys-case-draft

4) DocuSign: don't sign until legal redlines are accepted. Kimberly, once you provide final in-line language I'll put together a clean order form to re-send via DocuSign.

Action items:
- Kimberly: finalize quote approval clause and mark which positions require CRO escalation (by EOD 5/30).
- Dev: bundle assets and upload by EOD 5/30.
- Marissa: coordinate with Novasys on final press text and set embargo calendar (aiming Jun 12).

I'll hold on communicating any concession offers until Kimberly confirms the legal language.

Thanks,
Marissa
